hotel_1star_semantic.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Tokyo? Hotel Prices for Tokyo, Japan | Budget Your Trip
hotel_1star_semantic.evidenceText: On the exact-city page, BudgetYourTrip reports an average 1-star hotel price of $29 based on 32 hotels and a median of $23. The page describes hotel prices per night, in US Dollars before taxes and fees, with a Kayak base price. It does not explicitly state two-person or two-adult occupancy.
hotel_1star_semantic.referencePeriod: BudgetYourTrip hotel-price analysis; page crawled 2 weeks before retrieval; prices are before taxes and fees and vary seasonally.
hotel_1star_semantic.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com/hotels Tokyo Japan 1-star hotel average price room for two taxes fees
hotel_1star_semantic.reason: Exact city/class, numeric nightly statistic, currency, sample, and tax exclusion were visible, but the page gives no explicit two-person occupancy. Source-default or unspecified occupancy fails this semantic experiment.
